programs.title: Bright Now S1 - "Night At The Aquarium"
programs.desc: Have you ever wondered what happens behind closed doors at zoos and aquariums? What do the animals do when no one is around to watch them? Catch a glimpse at the quirky happenings that guests normally don't get to see.

programs.title: Earthrise S1 - "Change of Power"
programs.desc: Earthrise goes to Norway and the Orkney Islands in the UK to explore two solutions with a part to play in the transition to a carbon neutral world.

programs.title: Earthrise S1 - "Healthy Eating"
programs.desc: Earthrise goes to the UK and Chile to explore how we can break our addiction to unsustainable meat and dairy products and eat dishes that are healthy both for people and the planet.
